mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE goods SET status = 'rejected', reject_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods(title, type, seller_id, start_price, current_price, min_increment, cover, description, status, end_at, created_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{type}, #{sellerId}, #{startPrice}, #{currentPrice}, #{minIncrement}, #{cover}, #{description}, #{status}, #{endAt}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT g.*, u.nickname AS seller_name FROM goods g LEFT JOIN user u ON g.seller_id = u.id WHERE g.seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY g.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET current_price = #{price} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT g.*, u.nickname AS seller_name, cb.nickname AS current_bidder_name FROM goods g LEFT JOIN user u ON g.seller_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user cb ON g.current_bidder_id = cb.id WHERE g.status = 'on_sale'
AND (g.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND g.type = #{type} ORDER BY g.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET current_bidder_id = #{bidderId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT g.*, u.nickname AS seller_name, cb.nickname AS current_bidder_name FROM goods g LEFT JOIN user u ON g.seller_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user cb ON g.current_bidder_id = cb.id WHERE g.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND g.status = #{status} AND g.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY g.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET end_at = #{endAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT g.*, u.nickname AS seller_name FROM goods g LEFT JOIN user u ON g.seller_id = u.id WHERE g.status IN ('sold', 'on_sale') AND g.end_at IS NOT NULL AND g.type = #{type} ORDER BY g.end_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
